# SmartMind

> SmartMind is a free AI learning app: AI tutor, smart quizzes, image editor, translator, writer and more. Designed to help students and lifelong learners learn faster online.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of SmartMind and its features.
- [Learn](/learn): Hybrid AI learning hub — ask questions, take quizzes, chat with the AI tutor.
- [Quiz](/quiz): Subject-based quizzes generated by AI.
- [Dev Mode](/dev): Interactive coding environment with lessons and challenges.
- [AI Writer](/ai-writer): Templates for letters, emails, blogs, captions and CVs with PDF/DOCX export.
- [Text Analyzer](/ai-detector): Local grammar, readability and keyword analysis.
- [Design Studio](/generate-image): In-browser image editor with filters, crop, text overlays.
- [App Planner](/build-app-prompt): Turn an app idea into features, pages, schema and a roadmap.
- [Translate](/translate): Free translator covering 100+ languages including Kinyarwanda.
- [Learning Hub](/youtube-tutor): Curated video courses across many subjects with roadmaps.
- [Homework Helper](/ai-homework-helper): Step-by-step AI homework explanations.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
